rows.notes: Xinhua 2025-10-01 reports the China Salt Lake Group '4+2' project (4 万 t/yr integrated basic lithium salt + 2 万 t/yr lithium carbonate) as 顺利投产 in Golmud; the 2 万 t carbonate project is the Huixin 20,000 t project (SMM June 2025 trial run/first product, same 2 万 t figure; the identification Huixin = the '+2' project rests on identical size and owner, the Xinhua page does not name Huixin). Xinhua 2026-09-29 gives China Salt Lake Group total lithium-salt capacity 11.5 万 t = Lanke 4 + integrated 4 + Huixin 2 + Yiliping 1.5 万 t, which matches our four rows (arithmetic check, not stated on the page). installed_as_of = Xinhua publication date (page says '日前', exact day not given). CONFLICT/flag for lead: the Qinghai Salt Lake Industry AR calls the separate 4 万 t integrated project trial production (kept under_construction by the lead audit); Xinhua calls it 投产 - not changed here. 'Huixin' = 青海汇信 (China Salt Lake subsidiary), NOT 青海恒信融 (Hengxinrong, separate row).

Second source for capacity: Wood Mackenzie free asset page (2026-06-18) states CITIC Guoan 'total capacity to 46 kt/a following CITIC Kunlun's integration in 2024' - agrees with the 45,000 t figure within 1 kt (conflict minor; 45,000 kept, WoodMac 46 kt may include rounding or a small add-on). 2025 output: NOT found in any open source (searched CITIC Guoan, SMM, Haixi pages); a user-posted industry list (xueqiu, not used) ranks Qinghai CITIC Guoan Technology 2nd among China's 2025 carbonate producers, unverified. Haixi Prefecture produced 17% of China's 2025 carbonate (stdaily 2026-08-11, https://www.stdaily.com/web/gdxw/2026-08/11/content_562196.html) and Qinghai province 16.9 万 t (see SC030), so this plant is probably one of the largest unattributed Qinghai producers. West Taijinaier lake mine scale approved in 2022 as 2.5 万 t/yr carbonate with CITIC Guoan and Hengxinrong as developers (search-result text from Securities Times 2022-04, page not opened; not used for numbers).

[SC195] Securities Times 2026-02-05 (Phoenix repost, on Dongfang Tech's strategic framework agreement with Dongtai Jinai'er Lithium Resources of 2026-02-04): 'two production lines have 20,000 t/yr lithium carbonate capacity' plus a 200,000 t/yr potash line. ref year = publication-year fallback; installed_as_of = page date (the sentence describes existing lines, no commissioning date; earlier press: 10,000 t first line planned 2018, 1.5 万 t actual in 2021, 2 万 t in Baidu Baike - search summaries). A further 30,000 t/yr battery-grade carbonate project from East Taijinaier raw brine passed its feasibility-report review on 2026-05-08 (S5) - undated, NOT added to capacity (D-015). No 2025 output disclosed (cf. SC120 revenue-implied ~18,000 t, order of magnitude only). OWNERSHIP FLAG: SMM 2021-07-26 (S6) says Dongtai 'is also the controlling shareholder of Qinghai Lithium Industry', whereas SMM/Solarbe 2025 call Qinghai Lithium Industry a CITIC Guoan subsidiary (the West Taijinaier row, 45,000 t). East vs West Taijinaier are different lakes so the two rows are kept separate, but if Dongtai's two lines are in fact inside Qinghai Lithium's 45 kt the lead should merge; not resolvable from open sources. 2021 shareholders per SMM: Qinghai Taifeng Xianxing 49.5%, Western Mining 27%, Qinghai Lianyu Potash 20.34%, Qinghai CITIC Guoan Technology 2.16%, Qinghai state-owned assets 1% (2021, may have changed).
